# AccessSync — LLM Context File
# Version: 1.0 | Updated: 2026-04-02 | Source: CLAUDE.md v3.9

## What Is AccessSync

AccessSync is a Wix App Market SaaS that automates physical door access control for gym
and fitness operators. When a member purchases a Wix pricing plan, AccessSync automatically
provisions their credentials in Kisi (the hardware access control system). When they cancel
or their payment fails, access is revoked — no manual operator action required.

First client: House of Gains (Chad) — Kisi Pro tier, $199/mo/location.
Platform: Node.js on Railway. Database: Postgres. Queue: BullMQ + Redis.
Status: V1 code-complete, pre-launch pending business gates.

---

## Pricing

- Base: $30/month/location
- Pro: $60/month/location
- Connect: $150/month/location
- Infrastructure cost: $35/month fixed (Railway $15 + Wix Studio $20)
- Unit economics: ~99% margin at scale

---

## 7-Layer Architecture (DR-022)

```
L1  adapters/wix/wix-connector.js       HTTP handler, HMAC-SHA256 verification
L2  adapters/wix/wix-adapter.js         Wix payload parsing → standard event object
L3  adapters/standard-adapter.js        Owns member_identity, member_access_state, in_flight lock
L4  core/                               Core Engine — queue, grant/revoke logic, reconciliation
L5  adapters/hardware-adapter.js        Platform router — delegates by hardwarePlatform string
L6  adapters/kisi/kisi-adapter.js       Kisi business methods
L7  adapters/kisi/kisi-connector.js     Kisi HTTP client, rate limiting
```

Layer 3 (Standard Adapter) EXCLUSIVELY owns member_identity writes and member_access_state writes.
Core Engine (Layer 4) NEVER writes these tables directly. (DR-023)
Hardware platform is resolved from DB — Core Engine never hardcodes 'kisi'. (DR-035)

---

## Standard Event Contract (DR-021)

All input adapters produce this normalized object:
```
{ eventType, platformMemberId, sourcePlatform, memberEmail, planId, tenantId }
```
Core Engine never references platform-specific IDs. Enables Squarespace, Brivo, etc. with zero
changes to Layers 3–5.

---

## Hardware Adapter Interface (Layer 5)

8 methods all hardware adapters must implement:
findUserByEmail, createUser, assignRole(options.validUntil for time-bounded), removeRole,
suspendAccess, enableAccess, deleteUser, getLocks

getLocks() returns normalized: { id, name, locked: boolean }

---

## Database — 14 Tables (PostgreSQL)

Foundation:
  clients              — tenants. hardware_api_key (AES-256-GCM encrypted). notification_email.
  locations            — physical sites per client. subscription_status. hardware_api_key override.
  plan_mappings        — source_plan_id → hardware_group_id translator.
  processed_event_ids  — idempotency / deduplication (DR-010)
  error_queue          — dead letter queue. dismiss_note, dismissed_by.

Access Adapter Layer:
  member_identity       — platform_member_id + source_platform + hardware_user_id (DR-021)
  member_access_state   — status: pending_sync | in_flight | active | disabled | revoked | failed
  member_role_assignments — one row per member per mapping. UNIQUE(member_id, mapping_id). (DR-026)
  member_access_log     — lifecycle events
  adapter_admin_log     — provisioning audit trail

Activity / Telemetry:
  client_activity_summary  — daily UPSERT: events_received, grants_completed, revokes_completed, errors_count (DR-024)
  config_alert_log         — operator configuration issue tracking

Observability:
  webhook_log     — every inbound Wix webhook. hmac_status, dedup_status, raw_payload.

IMPORTANT: schema.sql uses kisi_api_key — this is the baseline. Migration dr-035.sql renames to
hardware_api_key on Railway. Live DB column name is hardware_api_key.

---

## Locked Decisions — Do Not Revisit Without SAGE

DR-001  No PII storage — email re-pulled from Wix on-demand at reconciliation
DR-002  Access Adapter Layer is bidirectional identity bridge
DR-003  source_tag='accesssync' on all managed users — reconciliation scope boundary
DR-004  member_access_log is lifecycle table, not operational noise
DR-005  Kisi lockdown override — events skip (not fail) during Kisi lockdown
DR-006  Member sync screen is one-time post-purchase UI
DR-007  Kisi user type: managed users, send_emails: false (HOG exception: DR-017)
DR-008  Pricing locked: $30/$60/$150. Tier names: Base/Pro/Connect.
DR-009  Kisi legal — API connector model, Section 2.3(ii) flag resolved (attorney review pending)
DR-010  Idempotency via processed_event_ids table
DR-011  Kisi routes direct API, NOT through Seam
DR-012  Core Engine: BullMQ queue, Railway cron, configurable error email
DR-013  member_identity A/B schema — platform-agnostic (column names superseded by DR-021)
DR-014  Color system: Indigo #4F6EF7 (--brand) / Sage #4ADE80 (--sage) — not interchangeable
DR-015  Mobile-first: 320px baseline, FORGE + LENS enforce
DR-016  Velo direct install for House of Gains Phase 1
DR-017  HOG exception: regular users (not managed). DR-007 still active for all other clients.
DR-018  last_sync_at added as column to clients table (not separate sync_state table)
DR-019  adapter_admin_log: configured_by + configured_at (nullable)
DR-020  Operator email via Resend SDK. clients.notification_email per-client.
DR-021  member_identity platform-agnostic: platform_member_id + source_platform
DR-022  7-layer architecture — canonical layer model (see above)
DR-023  Layer 3 exclusively owns member_identity and member_access_state writes
DR-024  client_activity_summary — Standard Adapter Layer daily UPSERT, fault-tolerant
DR-025  locations table + plan_mappings.location_id + error_queue.location_id
DR-026  member_role_assignments — multi-door. payment.recovered = enableAccess only.
DR-027  Per-location subscription model. provisioning gated by subscription_status='active'.
DR-028  hardware_api_key: AES-256-GCM, clients (org default) + locations (nullable override)
DR-029  Sub-member ID format: {uuid}###as{NNN} — deterministic, reversible
DR-030  plan_holder_id column links sub-members to primary Wix member
DR-031  Family plan upstream explosion — Wix Adapter (L2) explodes into synthetic events
DR-032  Family plan draft→submit workflow — no provisioning until submit
DR-033  Unified member widget: single screen, planType param controls family/single/booking modes
DR-034  member_access_sources table — multi-source grant/revoke. Pre-grant check. Revoke only when zero sources remain.
DR-035  Platform-agnostic schema rename: kisi_api_key→hardware_api_key, wix_plan_id→source_plan_id

---

## Environment Variables

Core Engine (server.js):
  DATABASE_URL                         PostgreSQL connection string (Railway)
  WIX_WEBHOOK_SECRET                   HMAC secret from Wix developer dashboard
  KISI_ENCRYPTION_KEY                  32-byte hex for AES-256-GCM (hardware_api_key encryption)
  PORT                                 Set by Railway automatically
  NODE_ENV                             development | production
  DEFAULT_TENANT_ID                    Temporary — remove when multi-tenant routing complete
  RESEND_API_KEY                       Resend API key (resend.com)
  RESEND_FROM_EMAIL                    Sender address (e.g. alerts@accesssync.io)
  ACCESSSYNC_OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL  Platform owner email — HMAC alerts, reconciliation digest, fallback

Admin Hub (admin/server.js):
  ADMIN_JWT_SECRET                     64-char random string — JWT signing
  GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID                     OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Google Cloud Console)
  ADMIN_ALLOWED_EMAIL                  daxxroberts@gmail.com — only this account can log in
  OWNER_PIN                            Bypass PIN for onboarding (skips Kisi key validation)
  OPERATOR_INVITE_TOKEN                Shared secret for signup endpoints (OB-24)
  CORE_ENGINE_URL                      Core engine Railway URL — used by onboarding Step 5

## Deployment

Railway services:
  Core Engine:  node server.js
  Admin Hub:    node admin/server.js
  Cron 1:       node core/reconciliation.js (nightly)
  Cron 2:       node core/hardware-health-check.js (every 6 hours)
  Health check: GET /health (Core Engine) | GET /health (Admin Hub)

Pending Railway migrations before Sprint 5 deploy:
  migrations/dr-035.sql   — rename kisi_api_key → hardware_api_key
  migrations/sprint-5.sql — add hardware_key_last_verified, hardware_key_last_error, first_grant_sent

## Key File Reference

Adapters:
  adapters/wix/wix-connector.js        L1: HTTP + HMAC + hmac-monitor wiring
  adapters/wix/wix-adapter.js          L2: Wix payload parsing only
  adapters/standard-adapter.js         L3: identity/state/lock owner + first grant email
  adapters/hardware-adapter.js         L5: platform router + Gap 6 (validUntil)
  adapters/kisi/kisi-adapter.js        L6: Kisi methods + normalized getLocks()
  adapters/kisi/kisi-connector.js      L7: Kisi HTTP + rate limiting (5 req/sec)
  adapters/seam/seam-adapter.js        L6 stub — post-V1

Core:
  core/webhook-processor.js            BullMQ enqueue + dedup
  core/queue-worker.js                 Layer coordinator (concurrency: 20)
  core/grant-revoke.js                 Pure grant/revoke logic
  core/plan-mapping-resolver.js        source_plan_id → hardware_group_id lookup
  core/retry-engine.js                 Exponential backoff + dead letter
  core/reconciliation.js              Nightly sweep + operator digest
  core/hmac-monitor.js                 Redis HMAC spike alerting (Sprint 5.1)
  core/hardware-health-check.js        6-hourly key validation (Sprint 5.2)
  core/member-sync-api.js              RS256 JWT-verified member status API
  core/tenant-resolver.js              site_id → client_id (5-min cache)
  core/crypto-utils.js                 AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt
  core/location-lapse.js               Suspend all members at location on lapse

Admin:
  admin/server.js                      Crash-isolated Express app + 6 EJS page routes
  admin/routes/operator.js             Operator dashboard API (34 endpoints)
  admin/routes/clients.js              Clients panel (Admin JWT required)
  admin/routes/errors.js               Error queue management
  admin/routes/members.js              Debug center with email search
  admin/public/onboard.html            5-step operator onboarding wizard

Schema + Migrations:
  schema.sql                           14-table PostgreSQL schema (baseline)
  migrations/dr-035.sql                DR-035: kisi_api_key → hardware_api_key rename
  migrations/sprint-5.sql              Sprint 5: health check + first grant columns
